notes.title: Launch Day UPDATE.
notes.content:
After watching many Playthroughs and Reviews of the Game Pre-Launch I noticed a few things.

A lot of people didn't notice the call button at the top of the screen which will help you through the game.

Also how annoying it was to watch some scenes over and over.

So I have added a Tutorial Clip at the beginning of Game and also made all the longer scenes (Apart from opening and ending) Skippable.
